Instrumented baseline runs after the ori: Tried at 4 and 2 workers on this workload and rejected: PR #59 ran it concurrently on a second slot and measured no wall gain (4 workers: after/before 0.991 [0.957, 1.249]; baseline phases 1292 → 1282 ms) at +15% CPU. The two baselines are CPU-bound, so overlap does not reach this bound; only a shorter instrumented run would.
First mutant batch pays for cold lanes: Tried and rejected on this workload: PR #61 built the lane context on a spare controller during the baselines and was slower (after/before 1.082 at 4 workers), so moving that setup off the critical path did not help. It did not isolate createVitest from the other setup, so this report does not claim setup is free. This capture shows where the batch's time goes: cold per-lane module fetch and collect (184–290 ms against 19–64 ms in later batches) against 114 ms before its first fork.
